title: "Lab 14B: AI Model Ranking Review"
execute:
  enabled: false
---

## Goal

Audit a generated ranking that treats models fitted to different groups as a
single competition and ignores sample size, uncertainty, sensitivity, and
new-data evidence.

## Scenario

Download and run:

- [week14-ai-model-ranking-review.R](../code/r/week14-ai-model-ranking-review.R)

The generated output sorts monthly models by training R-squared, declares
September best, treats June's positive wind coefficient as causal, and promises
that the ranking will persist.

## Part A: Reconstruct The Ranking Rule

Identify the exact variable and direction used for sorting. List all evidence
columns that were available but excluded from the generated ranking.

## Part B: Claim-Evidence Table

Complete:

| Generated claim | Missing or contradictory evidence | Verdict | Repair |
|---|---|---|---|
| September is the best model |  |  |  |
| Wind increases ozone in June |  |  |  |
| The ranking will hold on future observations |  |  |  |
| Diagnostics do not affect the conclusion |  |  |  |

## Part C: Inspect June

Record June's sample size, wind point estimate, wind interval, diagnostic flag
count, and temperature-slope sensitivity change.

Explain separately why the causal claim and the certainty claim fail.

## Part D: Ask Whether Ranking Is Defined

For each comparison, decide whether a winner can be defined and why:

1. monthly models fitted to different subsets;
2. two formulas evaluated on the same training rows;
3. two frozen formulas evaluated on the same validation rows;
4. training and validation errors from different row sets.

## Part E: Replace Ranking With An Evidence Display

Create a table or plot retaining month, sample size, coefficient interval,
training metric, diagnostic flags, and sensitivity change. Write three cautious
pattern statements without ordinal ranks.

## Part F: Minimal Audit Tests

Add tests for group completeness, identical formula text, June's sample size,
its wind interval crossing zero, nonzero diagnostic flags for every month, and
the number of large sensitivity changes.

## Deliverable

Submit the completed claim-evidence table, June audit, comparison decisions,
replacement evidence display, minimal tests, and a 5-7 sentence repaired
interpretation.

## Exit Question

Complete this sentence:

> A model ranking is meaningful only when ...
